rules.S0_stops: Stage 0 stops the job (results/stage0.json 'stopped', .stopped marker, exit 1) on any of: an input or staged eap/ file whose sha256 differs from its record; a worker version (python, torch, transformer_lens, transformers) that does not start with the filed pin; a destination-coverage miss in tl_convert.convert (a converted parameter with no declared source that is not a bias, a declared destination the model lacks, a native key that is the source of nothing, an untied embedding, a shape mismatch), on M or x2; non-finite converted logits; any of rel_clean, rel_corrupted, rel_clean_all_positions, rel_corrupted_all_positions, rel_full_circuit_vs_clean, rel_empty_circuit_vs_corrupted over the floor, on M or x2. rel(a, b) is the largest per-window max |a - b| over max |b| (relative). The floor is the largest of the native forward's rel(batch 32, batch 1) over M and x2, clean and corrupted copy24 windows, read position. A floor of exactly 0 makes the bar exact equality, and the record shows it
rules.S0_recorded: Not stops: the do-nothing (M attributed twice on copy24) edge IoU, edge-set and score equality; the fp32 KL floor, the largest |KL| (the notebook's kl_divergence, mean over windows) of converted against native clean logits and of the converted model's batch 32 against batch 1, over M and x2; seconds per item and the projected total
rules.circuit: Per model and task set: the released attribute call; apply_topn(46, absolute=True); prune_dead_nodes. Ties at the 46th score are broken as the released sort breaks them (stable, in the graph's edge order), recorded as tie_at_cut. 'empty' = the logits node not in the graph after pruning
rules.no_gap: A model's F(M) (the notebook's KL of the full model from its corrupted run, mean over windows) at or under the stage-0 fp32 KL floor, or not finite: the faithfulness ratio is undefined and the model reads 'no gap' (calculate_faithfulness is not called, avoiding its division by zero). The same rule on b' (KL(clean || corrupted)) skips the greedy ladder
rules.reading: Per item, in this order: 'no gap' if either model reads no gap; 'empty' if either circuit is empty; 'circuit not faithful' if either circuit's Wang faithfulness is under 70%; else 'read'. Only 'read' items enter the headline; every item's raw numbers are in its JSON
rules.overlap: A = M's circuit, B = F's. Edge IoU = |A n B| / |A u B| over edge names; node IoU over nodes without 'input' and 'logits' (D8); the code's node IoU subtracts {'inputs', 'logits'} as Hanna's code does. An empty union gives None. Edge p = P(X >= x), X hypergeometric with population 927, |A| successes, |B| draws (D9); the code's p = P(X > x). Node p with population 28; the code's node p uses the code's sets against 28, None when a set exceeds 28. All exact (math.comb). Delta S = 100 x (added + removed) / |A|, for edges and for nodes (input and logits counted, as FC's JSON holds them); None when |A| = 0. Sizes after pruning are beside every number
rules.sensitivity_95: Section 4.3 beside: each circuit's own in-circuit edges at or above the 95th percentile (numpy, linear) of their |score|; nodes unfiltered; counts, IoU and moved edges. An empty circuit gives threshold None and no edges
rules.greedy: D12 beside: for n on the ladder, apply_greedy(n, absolute=True), prune, normalised faithfulness 1 - KL(clean || circuit) / KL(clean || corrupted) (means over windows, the notebook's KL); the smallest n at or above 0.85, else None ('none at 0.85 up to 927'); the IoU between M's and F's chosen circuits, None when either is None
rules.resampling: Per task set: 5 full-size resamples of the windows with replacement; M's circuit on each; the edge IoU of every two (10 pairs, an empty circuit's edge set is empty, None when both are); the range is [min, max] of the defined IoUs, None when none is defined. The same draws for F on x2 and on new_thin. A diagnostic beside the values; only control 2 and the matched randoms read it
rules.control_1: Pass iff x2's and M's 5% circuits on copy24 are both non-empty and have the same edge set, exactly. A miss is reported with the counts and the moved edges, never passed under a looser bar
rules.control_2: For new_few and new_thin each: pass iff its edge IoU against M on the cue windows is defined and strictly under the minimum of M's resampling range there. An undefined IoU or range reads 'no reading (miss)'
rules.matched_randoms: random_size_241001 (copy24) and random_kl_241002 (cue): 'pass' iff the edge IoU lies inside M's resampling range on its task set (min <= IoU <= max); reported, no stop
rules.reading_rule: If control 1 or either control 2 misses, every later stage still runs and its JSON lists the missed controls under method_failed_control: its values are those of a method that failed its control
rules.edge_cases_checked: Run before filing on overlap.py (2026-11-23, cpu-run): two empty circuits (IoU None, same_edges False, Delta S None, p 1.0 ours and 0.0 code); A empty, B not (IoU 0.0, Delta S None); identical circuits (IoU 1, same_edges True, Delta S 0); disjoint circuits (IoU 0, p ours 1.0 at x = 0); code node sets of 29 against 28 (code p None); a range with every IoU None (None; control 2 'no reading (miss)'); IoU equal to the range minimum (control 2 miss, inside pass); a 95th percentile over one edge (that edge kept)

expected.stage0: Coverage: 35 parameters assigned from 35 native keys (W_E from wte.weight, W_U from lm_head.weight, tied), 25 zero biases (b_Q, b_K, b_V, b_O, b_in, b_out per layer, b_U). Every parity rel at or under the floor; the floor itself about 1e-6 (fp32 GEMMs of batch 1 against 32); rel_full_circuit_vs_clean exactly 0 (the released hooks add exact zeros); rel_empty_circuit_vs_corrupted at or under the floor. Do-nothing: edge IoU exactly 1, the same edge set (scores bitwise equal expected, not required). fp32 KL floor far under every F(M) (the notebook divides KL by the 50,277 logits: F(M) on copy24 expected about 1e-4, the floor under 1e-9). About 5 to 15 s per item (export, load, attribution, faithfulness, ladder), about 15 to 30 min in all
expected.resampling: M against M: measured, no bar; Wang's Fig. 2 right reads about 0.98 to 0.94 for Pythia at 10-90% perturbation, 0.55 for a random model
expected.x2: control 1: the same edge set as M's on copy24, exactly (edge IoU 1); one moved edge would read about 0.96-0.98, so counts go beside
expected.rebuilt: no lean (MLP1's 8 columns zeroed, MLP2's and MLP3's weights replaced: three MLP nodes change)
expected.new_few, new_thin: control 2: edge IoU under the minimum of M's resampling range on the cue windows
expected.random_size_241001, random_kl_241002: edge IoU inside M's resampling range on their windows
expected.e62: no lean (E97 Amendment 1: both fine-tunes keep both of the original model's circuits); head (2,4)'s place in M's copy circuit reported
expected.key_grid: no lean filed; E237's R_vpd order (copy high, cipher low) beside
